title: Glitch
tagline: Glitch lets anyone turn a simple idea into a fully playable onchain game in seconds.
description: Glitch is a creator-first platform that turns plain-English prompts into fully playable onchain mini-games in seconds. Creators type an idea, pick a template, and Glitch generates, deploys, and monetizes the game end-to-end. Players can instantly play in the browser, pay small fees in PYUSD, and join tournaments—with instant, programmable payouts to creators.
how_its_made:
Glitch is built using a modular stack that combines AI, web, and blockchain layers to make game creation feel instant. The frontend is built with Next.js and React, styled with TailwindCSS, and uses lightweight Canvas and Phaser templates for mini-games. Instead of generating entire games from scratch, the AI layer powered by Qwen parses prompts and maps them to prebuilt game templates. This makes it fast and reliable while still feeling creative and dynamic. Assets and logic are injected on the fly, so creators can spin up a playable game in seconds.

Onchain payments and monetization are powered by PYUSD. Smart contracts handle entry fees, payouts, and tournaments, using Thirdweb for quick deployment and wallet abstraction. A lightweight backend on Vercel with Supabase stores session data and game metadata. The glitchy retro UI is created with CSS effects and small JavaScript tweaks to keep everything smooth and fast. This mix of prompt-to-template generation using Qwen, stablecoin payments, and glitchy arcade design makes Glitch both simple to use and technically solid.
